entries.title: NEMA 17 stepper motor
entries.description: Reference body for brackets and enclosures: chamfered housing, pilot boss, 4× M3 holes on the 31 mm square, D-flat shaft.

entries.title: GT2 pulley, 20T
entries.description: GT2 timing pulley for 6 mm belt, 5 mm bore, two M3 set screws. `teeth` drives the diameter and the groove count.

entries.title: M3 heat-set insert boss
entries.description: Printable 8 mm boss with the pocket for a standard M3 × 5.7 brass insert, a lead-in chamfer and a screw-tip clearance.

entries.title: Arduino Uno R3
entries.description: PCB outline and mounting holes, USB-B and barrel jack overhangs, headers, ICs and LEDs, each its own body.

entries.title: Flange
entries.description: A round plate with a centre bore and a ring of bolt holes. Set the diameter, bore, bolt circle, hole count and size, and thickness.
